svg.title: Considea: Human-gated multi-agent ideation
svg.desc: Implemented Considea architecture. Each member privately interacts with an Interview Agent and approves an editable summary before disclosure. An LLM-based Negotiator analyzes semantic differences and generates source-grounded clarification questions; affected members answer. Rounds one through three return to interviews. From round four, every member must vote to generate; any divergence restarts discussion. The Idea Generator creates or revises candidates, and the Evaluator uses Tavily retrieval and a source ledger to assess novelty and feasibility. All members must accept the same candidate and evaluation versions to finalize a brief. Agreed revisions are reevaluated and require fresh approvals. Personal clarifications remain visible only to the respondent. A Python workflow orchestrator mediates every transition, authorizes projections, validates versions, and coordinates leased tasks. The browser is hosted on Vercel, the backend and Node/Pi agents run on Render, and PostgreSQL retains private and shared state. DeepSeek provides model inference. SpacetimeDB and Mem0 are omitted because they are not part of the active deployment. The logical arrows in the upper panel are mediated workflow transitions, not direct agent-to-agent API calls.
svg.text: Private elicitation / shared deliberation / evidence-grounded proposals
A separate interview for every member
Human answers in every discussion round
The workflow engine mediates every transition above.
State machine · authorization · human events · version validation
Leased tasks · bounded retries · durable state transitions · per-member views
Node/Pi workers for all four agents
